notes: Independent critic review of Part C only. Read BRIEF-14 in full and the earlier drawing/registration/reduction methods in NOTES. No output art, conifer, ground, reference, notes or other pre-existing file was edited. VERDICT BASIS: all eight fail the requested unchanged seasonal outer-silhouette criterion. The measured bounding boxes and feet match exactly, but the actual outer crown contours do not. Interior transparent gaps are necessary for bare deciduous crowns and are not, by themselves, the reason for failure; the cited winter pixels extend beyond the summer envelope and several apexes move sideways. MEASUREMENTS: zero-based coordinates; bounding boxes are (left,top,right-exclusive,bottom-exclusive); foot columns are inclusive. Summer and winter values are identical for the following measurements: 0: bbox=(6, 8, 41, 45), visible=35x37, foot row=44, foot x=21..25, centre x=23, rows 41..44 alpha differences=0; 1: bbox=(10, 6, 37, 45), visible=27x39, foot row=44, foot x=21..25, centre x=23, rows 41..44 alpha differences=0; 2: bbox=(4, 12, 43, 45), visible=39x33, foot row=44, foot x=21..25, centre x=23, rows 41..44 alpha differences=0; 3: bbox=(6, 9, 41, 45), visible=35x36, foot row=44, foot x=22..25, centre x=23.5, rows 41..44 alpha differences=0; 4: bbox=(10, 6, 37, 45), visible=27x39, foot row=44, foot x=21..24, centre x=22.5, rows 41..44 alpha differences=0; 5: bbox=(5, 12, 43, 45), visible=38x33, foot row=44, foot x=20..27, centre x=23.5, rows 41..44 alpha differences=0; 6: bbox=(7, 10, 41, 45), visible=34x35, foot row=44, foot x=21..25, centre x=23, rows 41..44 alpha differences=0; 7: bbox=(10, 6, 38, 45), visible=28x39, foot row=44, foot x=22..25, centre x=23.5, rows 41..44 alpha differences=0. PASSING CHECKS: all eight are 48x48 RGBA with alpha values only 0 and 255, zero RGB under transparency, one 8-connected opaque component, and 9..12 opaque palette colours. Summer/winter opaque pixel counts by index are 816/637, 678/503, 771/577, 778/568, 736/461, 743/491, 742/562, 636/398. All end on row 44. There are no detached alpha specks, soft fringes, magenta edges, ground squares, haze, or green winter canopies. The snow reads as solid paint on upper branches. Native pixel size and light placement are consistent enough with the supplied town-tree references and neighbouring conifers. Oaks, upright beeches and pale-trunk birches are distinguishable; 2 and 4 retain sparse brown leaves. The staggered winter strip reads as a dense bare woodland, although the fine branches make it busy. VISUAL INSPECTION: viewed every target at exact 1x, nearest-neighbour 4x and 8x; every tree over both grass-base and grass@winter-base; summer/winter/conifer comparisons; registered alpha overlays; the supplied fantasy-tree@winter-0..3 references and 4x2 fantasy-treeline_forest@winter layout; broadleaf and mixed-conifer forest strips at 1x and 4x. Both unchanged grounds were inspected as literal full 3x3 repeats, with no new seam defect attributed to Part C. The independent 432x160 forest strips use 24px horizontal/20px vertical staggered placement with a 12px alternate-row offset. Composites are asset review, not a live-game rendering. METHOD AUDIT: independently recomputed all 25,344 8x8 mode blocks across eleven saved variants (1,622,016 source samples), with zero differences; applying the recorded native cleanup reproduces every candidate, and the eight selected candidates equal the output pixels. This validates reduction and recorded cleanup; it does not substitute for the silhouette review. Eleven 4x proofs were verified as exact nearest-neighbour enlargements, and all eighteen ground-repeat cells equal their source. Starting hashes in the independent proof PNG metadata confirm all pre-existing files remain byte-identical. Evidence files use the critic-r14C-1- prefix; measurement and starting-hash records are embedded in their PNG metadata. No commit, push or branch change.
